description: #39: fires when a pr-fix try fails because its agent hit its backend's usage limit (the bridge's capacity_exhausted, on any agent step of the fix loop: agent, agent_qwen, agent_codex), and runs queue-add-capacity: the level that ran out rests for vars.fixer_capacity_cooldown_s (fixer_cooldowns) and the PR goes back in the fixer queue at the back as a retry with the try's own instruction and a note, so queue.progress gives the next try the next available level (vars.fixer_unavailable). Shares the PR's key (it continues the chain, so the try's own hand-back is skipped), not an attempt itself: the failed try still counts toward the 3, never refunded. When the PR has used its 3 attempts the queue refuses the retry and the run hands back once.
name: PR fixer: rest the level and back in the queue after capacity_exhausted

on_failure.name: Hand back with the run link (once per chain)
